text.what: Fourteen communes between Dijon and Corgoloin holding 24 of Burgundy's 25 red grand cru appellations. Some of them are tiny — La Romanée covers less than a hectare.
text.how: The good ground sits mid-slope, where the scree drains and the sun reaches. Flat land near the village makes village wine; the top of the hill goes cold and thin.
